node.statement: Combining the two preceding children gives s * sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= nu_v. Since s > 0, division by s gives sum_{j in A_s} a_j^+ <= nu_v / s. Finally A_s = {j : h_j >= s} = {j : h(p_j) >= s} and a_j^+ = max(P_vj,0), which is exactly sum over {j : h(p_j) >= s} of max(P_vj,0) <= nu_v / s.
